messages:
maria-chen: heads up — saw a spike in SCIM provisioning failures for a few enterprise customers after the KMS key rotation last night. errors look like "missing external_id" but their idp logs show attribute truncation.
jonathan-li: can you paste an example saml response (sanitized)?
maria-chen: sure — truncated attr near the end, e.g.:
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="urn:custom:external_id">
    <saml:AttributeValue>abcd-very-long-external-id-that-gets-cut-off-...
  </saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
maria-chen: IdP is Okta for this customer, but note: the full external_id exists in their Okta user profile. our SCIM webhook is receiving the truncated value.
kevin-obrien: hmm — two possibilities: (1) IdP is truncating on the SAML assertion side due to attribute length limit, or (2) our ingress/load-balancer is truncating headers/body. do we see any 4xx/5xx at the sp-acs endpoint?
maria-chen: SP ACS returns 200 for the saml-post, then our scim worker errors out with 400 when mapping user\. Audit logs earlier show KMS decrypt succeeded for most tokens, but a handful show "decryption failed: unsupported key version" right around 03:12 UTC.
alyssa-devex: could the KMS rotation have changed payload encoding length causing some downstream middleware to hit a buffer/size check? weird but possible.
jonathan-li: can you grep the load balancer logs for Content-Length / Transfer-Encoding anomalies around 03:10-03:20? also check nginx client_max_body_size and proxy_buffer_size.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-042 (label: saml-scim-provisioning). assigned: oncall.
kevin-obrien: another quick test: ask the customer to toggle sending external_id as a separate attribute (e.g., urn:custom:externalIdAlt) or send the external_id trimmed to 64 chars and see if SCIM succeeds. if Okta is truncating, mapping a short stable id (like user principal) can be stopgap.
maria-chen: ran a quick replay of the raw saml payloads we logged — when the attribute length > 256 characters the last chunk gets replaced with "..." on our side. that suggests a post-processing step. searching codebase for 256 limit.
jonathan-li: i recall a legacy normalization step in the scim-ingress lambda that slugifies attributes and limits to 255 for database column. maybe the rotation caused a different serialization path to hit that code.
kevin-obrien: check the DB schema (users.external_id varchar(255) ?) and the scim-ingress code around attr normalization. if the DB column is 255 then we should fail upstream with 4xx instead of storing truncated.
maria-chen: confirmed: users.external_id is varchar(255). we need to avoid silent truncation. adding a validation and a clear 400 with reason. will open PR.
alyssa-devex: for customers using long external ids we should add a migration plan (extend column + index) and update docs/okta mapping guidance.
jonathan-li: in parallel, add a temporary mapping rule: if external_id is missing but email exists, set scim.externalId = email and surface a detailed audit log. that avoids mass deprovisioning while we fix schema.
kevin-obrien: on the KMS front — follow up: the decryption failures are a separate narrow noise from an old key-version still referenced by one batch job. i'll remove references and requeue failed jobs.
maria-chen: plan: 1) roll a quick patch to scim-ingress to validate attr length and return explicit 400; 2) apply short-term fallback mapping to email for provisioning; 3) DB migration to varchar(1024) + reindex in next maintenance window; 4) confirm KMS key-version cleanup.
jonathan-li: ping me when the patch PR is up, i'll review tonight. also please dump the Okta assertion settings and check "Attribute length limit" or any sign of truncation rules.
alyssa-devex: i'll update the customer-facing KB with mitigation steps and sample Okta mappings: `external_id -> user.profile.externalId` and `fallback -> user.email` plus a note about long ids.
sre-bot: update: incident INC-2026-042 status changed to investigating.
maria-chen: thanks all. leaving a note: after applying the quick patch provisioning succeeded for the test customer with a >600 char external_id once we forced the mapping to email — means our validation path worked. will follow up with migration timeline. :thumbsup:
kevin-obrien: also added an alert to KMS audit for "decryption error: unsupported key version" to catch regressions.
jonathan-li: great. close the loop once DB migration ticket is scheduled and KB is live.
alyssa-devex: putting a short checklist in the KB for SAML + SCIM troubleshooting (attribute mapping, attr length, KMS errors, proxies).
maria-chen: excellent. marking this thread resolved for now. will paste PR and migration ticket in the incident later. :v:
